column3: Oud Muattar Ghanaati is a fragrant (incense) dukhoon that combines the rich aroma of oud with a delightful perfume blend, offering a unique bakhar (smoke fragrance) experience. This particular scent features a captivating composition with top notes of pineapple, bergamot, orange, saffron, plum, and lemon. Its heart notes consist of the floral essences of rose, jasmine, and lily of the valley, while the base notes provide a warm and lasting impression with tonka, amber, and cedarwood. To enjoy this incense, simply place the wood chips on top of a coal and allow the smoke to fill the air, creating a pleasant ambiance in various spaces such as the living room, wardrobe, cars, or on clothes. It is important to keep the incense in a high place and out of reach of children, as it is flammable. Directions for use: Place a coal on a bukhoor burner and ensure to use a foil underneath to prevent overheating. Place the Bukhoor tablet on the coal to release the captivating fragrance. Keep the burner on elevated surfaces, away from flames, direct heat, and sunlight. Remember to store it out of reach of children for safety.
